title: FAP Seven Principles for Making Marriage Work
intro: Learn to apply the seven principles of marriage, increase respect and appreciation, address perpetual problems with conflict resolution skills, and build a shared sense of purpose and values in your relationship.

sections.markdown:
Suited for couples who are contemplating marriage all the way to couples who have been married for many years and are seeking to deepen their relationship.

Inappropriate for couples that have severe relational distress or where emotional/physical abuse is present or where severe mental health/substance use issues are present.
